item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 26/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry replenishment of the northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China gradually tomorrow. The weather will become cool over the region. With the band of clouds covering Guangdong thinning out, it will become fine and dry over the region over the weekend. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large over inland areas. The monsoon is expected to moderate early to midweek next week. Daytime temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly.

Date/Month: 27/12 (Friday)
Wind: Northeast force 4, becoming north force 5.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two light rain patches. Bright periods in the afternoon. Becoming cool at night.
Temp range: 17 - 20 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
